items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He loved the drummer that was actually my famous drummer in all the world. He name was Stump Saunders

ctx.x: To move back to Steeplechase, and actually before that I want to talk to you a bit about Billy Hart. Now, I understand he apprenticed in your ensemble at seventeen.

Yeah. You know, I met Billy, Billy was about fourteen years old and he used to come around the clubs. He loved the drummer that was actually my famous drummer in all the world. He name was Stump Saunders, and he passed a couple of years ago. But he loved Stump, and he loved what we were doing. He‘d come and we were working someplace way up 14th Street, and the man who ran the place was a drummer, and he got to know and like Billy. He let him come in and he‘d sit back behind the stage and listen to Stump. Yeah, he…
How long was he in your ensemble?
